 Our Goal is to answer this question Is there a difference between the alcohol consumed between the row
 you choose to sit in??

# Introduction  
The question is this: Is there a relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink?  
Data is from Uc Davis Math 116 class.  
$H_0$ There is no relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink.   
$H_A$ There is a relationship between where you sit in class and how much you drink.  


# Methods 
Seat is a categorical variable.   
Alcohol is a numerical variable. 



# Data Summaries. 


## Now add in boxplot

```{r}
boxplot(alcohol~Seat,data=davisdata)
```
    
    
  The plot show that students who sit in the back tend to drink more oz/per week of alcohol than students who sit in the front or in the middle of the class.
